verses.en: Jude, the servant of Jesus Christ, and brother of James, to them that are sanctified by God the Father, and preserved in Jesus Christ, and called:
verses.fr: Jude, serviteur de Jésus-Christ, et frère de Jacques, à ceux qui ont été appelés, qui sont aimés en Dieu le Père, et gardés pour Jésus Christ:
verses.am: የኢየሱስ ክርስቶስ ባሪያ የያዕቆብም ወንድም የሆነ ይሁዳ፥ በእግዚአብሔር አብ ተወደው ለኢየሱስ ክርስቶስም ተጠብቀው ለተጠሩ፤

verses.en: Mercy unto you, and peace, and love, be multiplied.
verses.fr: que la miséricorde, la paix et la charité vous soient multipliées!
verses.am: ምሕረትና ሰላም ፍቅርም ይብዛላችሁ።

verses.en: Beloved, when I gave all diligence to write unto you of the common salvation, it was needful for me to write unto you, and exhort you that ye should earnestly contend for the faith which was once delivered unto the saints.
verses.fr: Bien-aimés, comme je désirais vivement vous écrire au sujet de notre salut commun, je me suis senti obligé de le faire afin de vous exhorter à combattre pour la foi qui a été transmise aux saints une fois pour toutes.
verses.am: ወዳጆች ሆይ፥ ስለምንካፈለው ስለ መዳናችን ልጽፍላችሁ እጅግ ተግቼ ሳለሁ፥ ለቅዱሳን አንድ ጊዜ ፈጽሞ ስለ ተሰጠ ሃይማኖት እንድትጋደሉ እየመከርኋችሁ እጽፍላችሁ ዘንድ ግድ ሆነብኝ።

verses.en: For there are certain men crept in unawares, who were before of old ordained to this condemnation, ungodly men, turning the grace of our God into lasciviousness, and denying the only Lord God, and our Lord Jesus Christ.
verses.fr: Car il s''est glissé parmi vous certains hommes, dont la condamnation est écrite depuis longtemps, des impies, qui changent la grâce de notre Dieu en dissolution, et qui renient notre seul maître et Seigneur Jésus-Christ.
verses.am: ከብዙ ጊዜ በፊት ለዚህ ፍርድ የተጻፉ አንዳንዶች ሰዎች ሾልከው ገብተዋልና፤ ኃጢአተኞች ሆነው የአምላካችንን ጸጋ በሴሰኝነት ይለውጣሉ ንጉሣችንንና ጌታችንንም ብቻውን ያለውን ኢየሱስ ክርስቶስን ይክዳሉ።

verses.en: I will therefore put you in remembrance, though ye once knew this, how that the Lord, having saved the people out of the land of Egypt, afterward destroyed them that believed not.
verses.fr: Je veux vous rappeler, à vous qui savez fort bien toutes ces choses, que le Seigneur, après avoir sauvé le peuple et l''avoir tiré du pays d''Egypte, fit ensuite périr les incrédules;
verses.am: ዳሩ ግን ሁሉን አንድ ጊዜ ፈጽሞ ምንም የተማራችሁ ብትሆኑ ጌታ ከግብፅ አገር ሕዝቡን አድኖ የማያምኑትን በኋላ እንዳጠፋቸው ላሳስባችሁ እወዳለሁ።

verses.en: And the angels which kept not their first estate, but left their own habitation, he hath reserved in everlasting chains under darkness unto the judgment of the great day.
verses.fr: qu''il a réservé pour le jugement du grand jour, enchaînés éternellement par les ténèbres, les anges qui n''ont pas gardé leur dignité, mais qui ont abandonné leur propre demeure;
verses.am: መኖሪያቸውንም የተዉትን እንጂ የራሳቸውን አለቅነት ያልጠበቁትን መላእክት በዘላለም እስራት ከጨለማ በታች እስከ ታላቁ ቀን ፍርድ ድረስ ጠብቆአቸዋል።

verses.en: Even as Sodom and Gomorrha, and the cities about them in like manner, giving themselves over to fornication, and going after strange flesh, are set forth for an example, suffering the vengeance of eternal fire.
verses.fr: que Sodome et Gomorrhe et les villes voisines, qui se livrèrent comme eux à l''impudicité et à des vices contre nature, sont données en exemple, subissant la peine d''un feu éternel.
verses.am: እንዲሁም እንደ እነርሱ ዝሙትን ያደረጉና ሌላን ሥጋ የተከተሉ ሰዶምና ገሞራ በዙሪያቸውም የነበሩ ከተማዎች በዘላለም እሳት እየተቀጡ ምሳሌ ሆነዋል።

verses.en: Likewise also these filthy dreamers defile the flesh, despise dominion, and speak evil of dignities.
verses.fr: Malgré cela, ces hommes aussi, entraînés par leurs rêveries, souillent pareillement leur chair, méprisent l''autorité et injurient les gloires.
verses.am: እንዲሁም እነዚህ ሰዎች ደግሞ እያለሙ ሥጋቸውን ያረክሳሉ ጌትነትንም ይጥላሉ ሥልጣን ያላቸውንም ይሳደባሉ።

verses.en: Yet Michael the archangel, when contending with the devil he disputed about the body of Moses, durst not bring against him a railing accusation, but said, The Lord rebuke thee.
verses.fr: Or, l''archange Michel, lorsqu''il contestait avec le diable et lui disputait le corps de Moïse, n''osa pas porter contre lui un jugement injurieux, mais il dit: Que le Seigneur te réprime!
verses.am: የመላእክት አለቃ ሚካኤል ግን ከዲያብሎስ ጋር በተከራከረ ጊዜ ስለ ሙሴ ሥጋ ሲነጋገር። ጌታ ይገሥጽህ አለው እንጂ የስድብን ፍርድ ሊናገረው አልደፈረም።

verses.en: But these speak evil of those things which they know not: but what they know naturally, as brute beasts, in those things they corrupt themselves.
verses.fr: Eux, au contraire, ils parlent d''une manière injurieuse de ce qu''ils ignorent, et ils se corrompent dans ce qu''ils savent naturellement comme les brutes.
verses.am: እነዚህ ግን የማያውቁትን ሁሉ ይሳደባሉ፥ አእምሮም እንደሌላቸው እንስሶች በፍጥረታቸው በሚያውቁት ሁሉ በእርሱ ይጠፋሉ።

verses.en: Woe unto them! for they have gone in the way of Cain, and ran greedily after the error of Balaam for reward, and perished in the gainsaying of Core.
verses.fr: Malheur à eux! car ils ont suivi la voie de Caïn, ils se sont jetés pour un salaire dans l''égarement de Balaam, ils se sont perdus par la révolte de Coré.
verses.am: ወዮላቸው፥ በቃየል መንገድ ሄደዋልና ስለ ደመወዝም ለበለዓም ስሕተት ራሳቸውን አሳልፈው ሰጥተዋል በቆሬም መቃወም ጠፍተዋል።

verses.en: These are spots in your feasts of charity, when they feast with you, feeding themselves without fear: clouds they are without water, carried about of winds; trees whose fruit withereth, without fruit, twice dead, plucked up by the roots;
verses.fr: Ce sont des écueils dans vos agapes, faisant impudemment bonne chère, se repaissant eux-mêmes. Ce sont des nuées sans eau, poussées par les vents; des arbres d''automne sans fruits, deux fois morts, déracinés;
verses.am: እነዚህ ከእናንተ ጋር ሲጋበዙ በፍቅር ግብዣችሁ እንደ እድፍ ናቸው፤ እንደ እረኞች ያለ ፍርሃት ራሳቸውን ይጠብቃሉ፤ በነፋስ የተወሰዱ ውኃ የሌለባቸው ደመናዎች፥ ፍሬ የማያፈሩ ሁለት ጊዜ የሞቱ ከነሥራቸው የተነቀሉ በበጋ የደረቁ ዛፎች፥

verses.en: Raging waves of the sea, foaming out their own shame; wandering stars, to whom is reserved the blackness of darkness for ever.
verses.fr: des vagues furieuses de la mer, rejetant l''écume de leurs impuretés; des astres errants, auxquels l''obscurité des ténèbres est réservée pour l''éternité.
verses.am: የገዛ ነውራቸውን አረፋ እየደፈቁ ጨካኝ የባሕር ማዕበል፥ ድቅድቅ ጨለማ ለዘላለም የተጠበቀላቸው የሚንከራተቱ ከዋክብት ናቸው።

verses.en: And Enoch also, the seventh from Adam, prophesied of these, saying, Behold, the Lord cometh with ten thousands of his saints,
verses.fr: C''est aussi pour eux qu''Enoch, le septième depuis Adam, a prophétisé en ces termes: Voici, le Seigneur est venu avec ses saintes myriades,
verses.am: እነዚህ እንደ ምኞታቸው እየሄዱ የሚያንጎራጉሩና ስለ ዕድላቸው የሚያጕረመርሙ ናቸው፥ እንዲረባቸውም ለሰው ፊት እያደሉ አፋቸው ከመጠን ይልቅ ታላቅ ቃል ይናገራል።

verses.en: To execute judgment upon all, and to convince all that are ungodly among them of all their ungodly deeds which they have ungodly committed, and of all their hard speeches which ungodly sinners have spoken against him.
verses.fr: pour exercer un jugement contre tous, et pour faire rendre compte à tous les impies parmi eux de tous les actes d''impiété qu''ils ont commis et de toutes les paroles injurieuses qu''ont proférées contre lui des pécheurs impies.
verses.am: እነዚህ እንደ ምኞታቸው እየሄዱ የሚያንጎራጉሩና ስለ ዕድላቸው የሚያጕረመርሙ ናቸው፥ እንዲረባቸውም ለሰው ፊት እያደሉ አፋቸው ከመጠን ይልቅ ታላቅ ቃል ይናገራል።

verses.en: These are murmurers, complainers, walking after their own lusts; and their mouth speaketh great swelling words, having men's persons in admiration because of advantage.
verses.fr: Ce sont des gens qui murmurent, qui se plaignent de leur sort, qui marchent selon leurs convoitises, qui ont à la bouche des paroles hautaines, qui admirent les personnes par motif d''intérêt.
verses.am: እናንተ ግን፥ ወዳጆች ሆይ፥ በጌታችን በኢየሱስ ክርስቶስ ሐዋርያት ቀድሞ የተነገረውን ቃል አስቡ፤

verses.en: But, beloved, remember ye the words which were spoken before of the apostles of our Lord Jesus Christ;
verses.fr: Mais vous, bien-aimés, souvenez-vous des choses annoncées d''avance par les apôtres de notre Seigneur-Jésus Christ.
verses.am: እነርሱ። በመጨረሻው ዘመን በኃጢአተኝነት እንደ ገዛ ምኞታቸው እየሄዱ ዘባቾች ይሆናሉ ብለዋችኋልና።

verses.en: How that they told you there should be mockers in the last time, who should walk after their own ungodly lusts.
verses.fr: Ils vous disaient qu''au dernier temps il y aurait des moqueurs, marchant selon leurs convoitises impies;
verses.am: እነዚህ የሚያለያዩ ሥጋውያንም የሆኑ መንፈስም የሌላቸው ሰዎች ናቸው።

verses.en: These be they who separate themselves, sensual, having not the Spirit.
verses.fr: ce sont ceux qui provoquent des divisions, hommes sensuels, n''ayant pas l''esprit.
verses.am: እናንተ ግን፥ ወዳጆች ሆይ፥ ከሁሉ ይልቅ በተቀደሰ ሃይማኖታችሁ ራሳችሁን ለማነጽ እየተጋችሁ በመንፈስ ቅዱስም እየጸለያችሁ፥

verses.en: But ye, beloved, building up yourselves on your most holy faith, praying in the Holy Ghost,
verses.fr: Pour vous, bien-aimés, vous édifiant vous-mêmes sur votre très sainte foi, et priant par le Saint-Esprit,
verses.am: ወደ ዘላለም ሕይወት የሚወስደውን የጌታችንን የኢየሱስ ክርስቶስን ምሕረት ስትጠባበቁ በእግዚአብሔር ፍቅር ራሳችሁን ጠብቁ።

verses.en: Keep yourselves in the love of God, looking for the mercy of our Lord Jesus Christ unto eternal life.
verses.fr: maintenez-vous dans l''amour de Dieu, en attendant la miséricorde de notre Seigneur Jésus-Christ pour la vie éternelle.
verses.am: አንዳንዶች ተከራካሪዎችንም ውቀሱ፥ አንዳንዶችንም ከእሳት ነጥቃችሁ አድኑ፥

verses.en: And of some have compassion, making a difference:
verses.fr: Reprenez les uns, ceux qui contestent;
verses.am: አንዳንዶችንም በሥጋ የረከሰውን ልብስ እንኳ እየጠላችሁ በፍርሃት ማሩ።

verses.en: And others save with fear, pulling them out of the fire; hating even the garment spotted by the flesh.
verses.fr: sauvez-en d''autres en les arrachant du feu; et pour d''autres encore, ayez une pitié mêlée de crainte, haïssant jusqu''à la tunique souillée par la chair.
verses.am: ሳትሰናከሉም እንዲጠብቃችሁ፥ በክብሩም ፊት በደስታ ነውር የሌላችሁ አድርጎ እንዲያቆማችሁ ለሚችለው

verses.en: Now unto him that is able to keep you from falling, and to present you faultless before the presence of his glory with exceeding joy,
verses.fr: Or, à celui qui peut vous préserver de toute chute et vous faire paraître devant sa gloire irrépréhensibles et dans l''allégresse,
verses.am: ብቻውን ለሆነ አምላክና መድኃኒታችን ከዘመን ሁሉ በፊት አሁንም እስከ ዘላለምም ድረስ በጌታችን በኢየሱስ ክርስቶስ ክብርና ግርማ ኃይልም ሥልጣንም ይሁን፤ አሜን።

verses.en: To the only wise God our Saviour, be glory and majesty, dominion and power, both now and ever. Amen.
verses.fr: Dieu seul, notre Sauveur, par Jésus-Christ notre Seigneur, soient gloire, majesté, force et puissance, dès avant tous les temps, et maintenant, et dans tous les siècles! Amen!
verses.am: ብቻውን ለሆነ አምላክና መድኃኒታችን ከዘመን ሁሉ በፊት አሁንም እስከ ዘላለምም ድረስ በጌታችን በኢየሱስ ክርስቶስ ክብርና ግርማ ኃይልም ሥልጣንም ይሁን፤ አሜን።
